answer: One defence is Hardware wallet signature with BIP32 path proof: a signature from a path only that wallet owns, and the mesa of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate a signature from a path only that wallet owns a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the jetty of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the quill of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
